field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_thedataprotectionpolicybeenupdatedforgdpr1
field.label: The Data Protection Policy been updated for GDPR
field.description: Have staff been made aware of the policy and do they understand their responsibilities relating to data protection?

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_privacynoticeshavebeenupdatedforgdpr
field.label: Privacy Notices have been updated for GDPR
field.description: Make sure the privacy statement is on the school website.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_asubjectaccessprocedurehasbeenimplemented
field.label: A Subject Access Procedure has been implemented
field.description: Use the DPE SAR Procedure for the School. The SAR log can also be used for recording SARs centrally.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_adatabreachprocedurehasbeenimplemented
field.label: A Data Breach Procedure has been implemented
field.description: Use the DPE data breach procedure for the school and disseminate to staff. Ensure all staff understand the procedure for reporting a data breach (incident) and use the data breach/incident log to record centrally.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_policiesandproceduresforworkingoutofschoolhavebeenimplemented
field.label: Policies and procedures for working out of school have been implemented
field.description: Do staff understand their responsibilities for handling data away from school? See the policy in the Best Practice Library for guidance.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_informationclassificationhasbeenimplemented
field.label: Information classification has been implemented
field.description: Information assets are pieces of information such as a student record, or employee records. The Record of Processing Tool will support this process for you.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_photoandvideoguidelineshavebeenimplemented
field.label: Photo and video guidelines have been implemented
field.description: See the Best Practice Library for guidance.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_consentegforphotosiscollectedanddocumented
field.label: Consent (e.g. for photos) is collected and documented
field.description: Is consent collected and documented? Have you downloaded and read the latest DPE consent guidance?

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_subjectaccessrequestsarelogged
field.label: Subject Access Requests are logged
field.description: Do key staff understand the SAR procedure, how to respond to a SAR and how to log a SAR?

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_clusterclusterid
field.label: School

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_dataprotectionhasgovernortrusteebuyin
field.label: Data protection has Governor/Trustee buy-in
field.description: Ensure a governor has been appointed for GDPR. Involve them in internal walks and record findings in your data breach/incident log. Add GDPR as a regular item at governor meetings and use this toolkit to show progress.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_dataprotectionhasleadershipmanagementbuyin
field.label: Data protection has Leadership/Management buy-in
field.description: Update staff Code of Conduct/ICT to include GDPR. Have you thought about using the DPE: Clear Desk and Screen Policy? Use this toolkit and reports to keep the SLT updated.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_dataprotectionhasstaffbuyin
field.label: Data protection has staff buy-in
field.description: The recording and monitoring of staff training will be a vital aspect of evidencing this. Therefore, use the reports to ensure all staff complete the DPE e-learning or similar training.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_anindividualhasbeenassignedtoleadongdprimplementation
field.label: An individual has been assigned to lead on GDPR implementation
field.description: This would normally be the headteacher or senior member of staff.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_datariskhasbeenaddedtotheorganisationsriskregister
field.label: Data risk has been added to the organisation's risk register
field.description: DPE will provide more guidance as to individual school risk registers. You should understand and document the risks to privacy with the data that is processed in your school.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_informationassetshavebeenidentifiedanddocumented
field.label: Information assets have been identified and documented
field.description: Information assets are pieces of information such as a student record, or employee records.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_informationprocesseshavebeenidentifiedanddocumented
field.label: Information processes have been identified and documented
field.description: The Record of Processing Tool will support this process for you.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_thirdpartyprocessorshavebeenidentified
field.label: Third-party processors have been identified
field.description: Update your privacy statement to list who you share data with. You are the controller and will enter into a contract with a provider who effectively processes data on your behalf.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_informationclassificationhasbeenimplementedonassetsandsystems
field.label: Information classification has been implemented on assets and systems
field.description: The Record of Processing Tool will support this process for you.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_lawfulbasisforeachprocessisidentifiedanddocumented
field.label: Lawful basis for each process is identified and documented
field.description: Article 6 of the GDPR sets out the lawful basis for processing. Your GDPR Policy and Privacy Statement gives more details and the Record of Processing tool will support this.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_gdprcompliantcontractsareinplacewithsuppliers
field.label: GDPR-compliant contracts are in place with suppliers
field.description: Check the contracts.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_processingactivitiesaredocumented
field.label: Processing activities are documented
field.description: Article 30 of the GDPR places responsibilities on controllers to maintain a record of processing activities under its responsibility. DPE’s Record of Processing tool can be used to support this.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_organisationalandtechnicalmeasuresareinplacetosecureandprotectdata
field.label: Organisational and technical measures are in place to secure and protect data
field.description: This could be anything from security of data stored on networks to security of physical data.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_databreachesarelogged
field.label: Data Breaches are logged
field.description: Do all staff understand what a data breach is and how to report this? To improve practice do you feedback the findings from audits and walks to staff?

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_adataprotectionofficerhasbeenappointed1
field.label: A Data Protection Officer has been appointed
field.description: This is Data Protection Education.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_dataprocessingriskshavebeenassessed
field.label: Data Processing risks have been assessed
field.description: Data risk inevitably has a significant influence with daily practice in schools and GDPR.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_riskassessmentshavebeendocumented
field.label: Risk assessments have been documented
field.description: Ensure data risk and management is on the school/MAT risk register

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_riskshaveamitigationplan
field.label: Risks have a mitigation plan
field.description: DPE will be providing a Risk Management Policy, risk assessment and a high level risk analysis.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_dataprivacyimpactassessmentshavebeenexecutedforhighriskprocesses1
field.label: Data privacy impact assessments have been executed for high risk processes
field.description: The Record of Processing Tool will help with this.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_risksaremonitoredandreviewedatleastannually1
field.label: Risks are monitored and reviewed at least annually
field.description: Update documentation when necessary.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_theorganisationisregisteredwiththeico
field.label: The organisation is registered with the ICO
field.description: Check your registration hasn't expired on the ICO website.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_DataProtectionEducationisregisteredwiththeICOastheorganisationsdataprotectionofficer
field.label: Data Protection Education is registered with the ICO as the organisation's data protection officer

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_theobligationstotheicoareunderstood
field.label: The obligations to the ICO are understood
field.description: The ICO is the supervisory authority and is the UK’s independent authority set up to uphold information rights in the public interest.

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_staffareawareofwhatconstitutesadatabreach1
field.label: Staff are aware of what constitutes a data breach
field.description: Have you asked your staff if they are all familiar with the procedure?

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_staffareawareofwhatconstitutesasubjectaccessrequest
field.label: Staff are aware of what constitutes a subject access request
field.description: Who in your school would be responsible for handling a SAR? Have they read the SAR procedure?

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_allstaffreceivedataprotectiontraining
field.label: All staff receive data protection training regularly
field.description: Have all staff been trained in your school? Is GDPR training part of the induction process for new staff?

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_Staffwithaccesstolargeamountsandspecialcategorydatareceiveextratraining
field.label: Staff with access to large amounts and special category data receive extra training

field.name: com_tjucm_commitmenttocompliance_CommentsNotes
field.label: Comments/Notes
field.hint: Type in notes for commitment to compliance
